settings.title: Fit & sizing
settings.content: Cut true-to-size. Measure your pet's chest and back length and check our size guide. Between sizes? Size up for sweaters and down for harnesses.

settings.title: Fabric & care
settings.content: Soft, pet-safe fabrics and non-toxic dyes. Machine wash cold, line dry.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free returns within 30 days if it doesn't fit. Ships in 1–2 business days.
